integrity: Proof gives explicit guarded profile formulas, back-and-forth, minimum canonical models and exact sum; standalone checker independently compares profile equality with greatest fixed-point guarded bisimulation on 7335 finite model pairs. Self-review only; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Precisely two nested equivalence relations plus k unary predicates and equality; no extra relation symbols, constants, counting or unguarded FO2. Rank five is an upper bound, not asserted optimal. Mathematical assertions are proved for finite and infinite nonempty structures; finite computation corroborates only small examples. Historical priority is qualified by accessible literature and remains subject to specialist predecessors.
title: Exact guarded theories and sharp canonical sizes for two nested equivalences
